answer: Social Matters >> Food & Drinks Question ID: 45727 Country: India Title: Vinegar Question: Use of vinegar that we do normally for the preparation of pickles at home is halal or haram? Answer ID: 45727 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 901/901/M=1434) The vinegar is halal hence it may be used for the preparation of pickles. If you have any doubt, write the reason and submit your query again. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
